title: How a Godly Man Corrects Himself Faster Than He Corrects You
caption:
Most guys run a soft standard on their own sin and a hard one on everyone else's. A godly man runs it backwards.

He catches his own sin before he's got a comment on yours. He apologizes first and explains later, if he needs to explain at all. His own promises answer to a stricter court than anyone else's ever will.

And none of the grace he gives you comes off his own tab. "Why do you look at the speck in your brother's eye and pay no attention to the log in your own?" Matthew 7:3.

Pull your own log first. Then go help him with his speck.

Save this and send it to the guy who needs the reminder that correction starts at home.

theme: He's hard on himself, gentle with others.
